lineage: S100 was rejected because its DOWN state preceded a positive mean 20-day BTC return and both pullback directions lost. S101 replaces both the slow symmetric state model and pullback executor. It does not retune S100.

architecture.up: BTC above SMA200 with positive 84-day momentum, at least 50% of the six-asset universe above SMA200, and at least 50% with positive 84-day momentum; two daily confirmations.
architecture.down: BTC below EMA50 with both 28-day and 84-day momentum negative, and no more than one third of the six assets with positive 28-day momentum; two daily confirmations.
architecture.long_executor: S99-style own SMA200 plus positive 84-day momentum, top three momentum/volatility rank, 28-day mean funding <= +0.0001. Market OI attention is the fraction of BTC/ETH/SOL with positive EMA7-versus-EMA28 OI oscillator; low attention scales long exposure to 75% rather than selecting direction.
architecture.short_executor: Only BTC/ETH/SOL; own close below EMA50, 28-day and 84-day momentum negative, 28-day mean funding >= -0.0001, and OI EMA7-versus-EMA28 spread >= +0.05%; top two downside momentum/volatility rank.
architecture.decision_frequency: Every seven days at UTC open using only information timestamped strictly earlier.

data.source: checksum-verified public Binance USD-M 1d, funding and 5m metrics archives

predeclared_robustness.regime_diagnostic: Sample every seven days and report subsequent 20-day BTC returns.
predeclared_robustness.bootstrap: 5000 deterministic circular 28-day blocks on stress daily returns.

historical_gate.full_stress: PnL > 0, Sharpe >= 0.50, max drawdown <= 15%, daily-PnL PF > 1.05, positive-month share >= 40%.
historical_gate.directions: At least five invested short decisions; long-regime and short-regime stress PnL each >= 0.
historical_gate.time_dispersion: Development and validation stress PnL > 0, retrospective stress PnL >= 0, severe full PnL > 0.
historical_gate.robustness: Both risk neighbors, both phase offsets, at least five of six leave-one-out replays and bootstrap p10 terminal PnL > 0.
historical_gate.promotion: Historical pass authorizes paper-forward only for at least 180 days and 26 weekly decisions; live disabled.

disclosures: S101 was designed after inspecting S100 and is not independent validation.
No S101 parameter may change after this file is hashed.
Open interest confirms participation and never identifies direction by itself.
